name: AI lab compute and infrastructure expense (company-disclosed, S-1)
description: Quarterly 'Compute and infrastructure' operating expense from the S-1 quarterly table.
methodology: Same table as ai_lab_revenue, row 'Compute and infrastructure'.

name: AI lab operating income (loss) (company-disclosed, S-1)
description: Quarterly GAAP operating income (loss) from the S-1 quarterly table (negative = loss).
methodology: Same table as ai_lab_revenue, row 'Operating income (loss)'.

name: AI lab operating income (loss) (media-reported)
description: Quarterly operating income/loss of private AI labs as relayed by media (definition per article, e.g. incl. SBC).
warning: MEDIA-REPORTED estimate (people familiar / investor decks). Not audited, not company-filed financials.
methodology: Hand-curated from news articles (app/registry/curated/ai_lab_media.yaml); each row stores outlet, article date, URL and a verbatim quote.

name: AI lab quarterly revenue (company-disclosed, S-1)
description: Quarterly revenue from the pre-IPO registration statement (S-1) quarterly statements-of-operations table. Unaudited quarterly data disclosed by the company; kept separate from listed-company reported financials.
methodology: EDGAR latest S-1/S-1/A/424B, table 'Quarterly Consolidated Statements of Operations', row 'Revenue', USD millions x 1e6; table must foot (revenue - total opex = operating income).

name: AI lab quarterly revenue (media-reported)
description: Quarterly revenue of private AI labs as relayed by media. Kept separate from the S-1 company-disclosed ai_lab_revenue.
warning: MEDIA-REPORTED estimate (people familiar / investor decks). Not audited, not company-filed financials.
methodology: Hand-curated from news articles (app/registry/curated/ai_lab_media.yaml); each row stores outlet, article date, URL and a verbatim quote.

name: AI lab annualized revenue run-rate (media-reported)
description: Point-in-time annualized revenue run-rate as relayed by media. Labs use different run-rate definitions (gross vs net of cloud partners); not comparable across companies.
warning: MEDIA-REPORTED estimate (people familiar / investor decks). Not audited, not company-filed financials.
methodology: Hand-curated from news articles (app/registry/curated/ai_lab_media.yaml); each row stores outlet, article date, URL and a verbatim quote.

name: AI revenue / run-rate (company disclosed, lower bound)
description: AI-specific revenue run-rate statements from 8-K earnings releases, stored verbatim. Currently only Amazon states one in its release ('Exceeded a $X billion annual revenue run rate for AWS's AI business') - a LOWER BOUND, not an exact figure. MSFT/GOOGL/META/ORCL do not state an AI revenue figure in their latest releases (call-only), so they remain unavailable. Not a comparable series; not used as a risk input.
warning: Lower bound ('exceeded'); company-defined, unaudited, single company.

params.note: LOWER BOUND - company says the run rate exceeded this amount.

patterns.AMZN: Exceeded an? \$(?P<v>[\d.]+) (?P<scale>billion) annual revenue run rate for AWS.s AI business

name: Azure and other cloud services revenue growth YoY (company-reported %)
description: Microsoft reports only the growth rate (not the dollar amount) of 'Azure and other cloud services' in its earnings release. Stored as a fraction.
methodology: 8-K EX-99.1 bullet 'Azure and other cloud services revenue increased X%' (as reported, not constant currency) / 100. Fiscal quarter = MSFT FY (June year-end); period_end is the calendar quarter-end date of the release.

patterns.MSFT: Azure and other cloud services revenue (?:increased|grew) (?P<v>\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%

name: Cloud segment operating income (MSFT Intelligent Cloud, Google Cloud, AWS)
description: Segment operating income from the same dimensional XBRL segment note as cloud_segment_revenue.
warning: Segment profit as defined by each company (allocation rules differ); not AI-specific.
methodology: SEC EDGAR filing XBRL instance, us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss on the segment member (see cloud_segment_revenue).

name: Cloud segment operating margin
description: cloud_segment_operating_income / cloud_segment_revenue for the same period.
methodology: segment operating income / segment revenue (same period_start/period_end).

name: Cloud segment revenue (MSFT Intelligent Cloud, Google Cloud, AWS)
description: Segment revenue from the DIMENSIONAL XBRL facts in each 10-Q / 10-K (us-gaap:StatementBusinessSegmentsAxis). Q4 comes only from the 10-K (fiscal year), so it is DERIVED as FY - 9M YTD (classification derived).
warning: Segments are broader than AI: MSFT Intelligent Cloud also holds server products, GitHub, Nuance and Enterprise services; Google Cloud includes Workspace; AWS includes all cloud services. Segment definitions are recast from time to time (MSFT FY2025), so long histories are not like-for-like. Azure growth % is NOT an XBRL fact.
methodology: SEC EDGAR filing XBRL instance, segment member per company (params.member_by_entity). Values are the as-filed segment note; each later filing that restates a period is stored as a new version.

name: Cloud segment revenue YoY growth
description: Quarterly cloud segment revenue vs the same quarter one year earlier (as-filed values; recasts not bridged).
methodology: value / value(1y earlier) - 1.

name: NVIDIA Data Center revenue (market platform)
description: NVIDIA revenue for the Data Center market platform, parsed from the DIMENSIONAL XBRL facts in each 10-Q / 10-K instance document on SEC EDGAR Archives (srt:ProductOrServiceAxis = nvda:DataCenterMember). The 10-K only reports the fiscal year, so Q4 is DERIVED as FY - 9M YTD (Q3 10-Q).
warning: Data Center includes networking and non-AI compute; it is the closest audited AI-demand proxy, not 'AI revenue'.
methodology: Source = SEC EDGAR filing XBRL instance (same numbers as the 10-Q/10-K revenue-by-market table). NVIDIA investor-relations press releases are not scraped: the SEC filing is the audited, machine-readable original.

name: AI-specific capex (company disclosed)
description: No hyperscaler reports AI-only capex as a structured, audited number. Would be qualitative/guidance from earnings calls.
warning: Unavailable - do NOT substitute total capex.

name: AWS segment additions to long-lived assets
description: Amazon's ASU 2023-07 segment disclosure us-gaap:SegmentExpenditureAdditionToLongLivedAssets for the AWS segment (property & equipment additions incl. finance leases, accrual basis - NOT the cash-flow capex line). Only filed since the 2024 segment-disclosure rules; earlier quarters are not available.
warning: AWS capex is the closest audited cloud/AI-infrastructure capex split, still not AI-only.
methodology: SEC EDGAR filing XBRL instance, [StatementBusinessSegmentsAxis=AWS, ConsolidationItemsAxis=OperatingSegments].

name: Forward capex guidance (verbatim, 8-K earnings release)
description: Management capex outlook quoted VERBATIM from the 8-K Item 2.02 EX-99.1 earnings release (stored as GuidanceItem rows with quote + URL, not as observations). Only META states a numeric capex range in its release; MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN and ORCL give capex commentary only on earnings calls (no official machine-readable transcript), so they remain UNAVAILABLE here.
methodology: Regex on EX-99.1 text: 'We anticipate|expect <year> capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, to be in the range of $X-Y billion'.

patterns.META: We (?:anticipate|expect) (?P<target>\d{4}) capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, to be in the range of \$(?P<low>[\d.]+) ?[-–] ?(?P<high>[\d.]+) (?P<scale>billion)

name: CapEx / Operating cash flow
description: capex_total divided by operating_cash_flow, same quarter. >1 means capex exceeds internally generated cash.
methodology: capex_total / operating_cash_flow, same period. Not computed when OCF <= 0.

name: CapEx / Revenue
description: capex_total divided by revenue, same quarter.
methodology: capex_total / revenue, same period.

name: Total company capital expenditures (cash)
description: Purchases of property & equipment from the cash-flow statement, quarterly. TOTAL COMPANY capex - this is NOT AI capex. No company tagged here discloses AI-only capex in XBRL.
warning: Total company CapEx, not AI-specific. Excludes finance-lease additions (material for MSFT/ORCL/META).
methodology: Cash-flow statements in 10-Q are year-to-date. Q1 is reported directly; Q2/Q3/Q4 are DERIVED as YTD(n) - YTD(n-3 months) unless the filer reports a discrete 3-month value (e.g. Amazon), in which case the reported value is used.

name: Big-4 hyperscaler capex (calendar-quarter sum)
description: Sum of capex_total for MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META for calendar quarters where all four have data.
warning: Total company CapEx, not AI-specific. ORCL excluded (non-calendar fiscal quarters).
methodology: Sum over MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META of capex_total with identical period_end; emitted only when all 4 present.

name: Big-4 hyperscaler capex YoY
description: YoY growth of the Big-4 calendar-quarter capex sum.
methodology: value / value(1y earlier) - 1.

name: CapEx YoY growth
description: Quarterly capex vs the same fiscal quarter one year earlier.
methodology: value / value(period ending ~1 year earlier, +/-20 days) - 1. Not computed when prior value <= 0.

name: Free cash flow (OCF - CapEx)
description: operating_cash_flow - capex_total for the same period.
methodology: FCF = operating_cash_flow - capex_total (same period_start/period_end). Simple definition; excludes finance-lease principal repayments.

name: FCF YoY growth
description: Quarterly FCF vs same quarter one year earlier.
methodology: value / value(1y earlier) - 1. Not computed when prior FCF <= 0 (growth from a negative base is meaningless).

name: Operating cash flow YoY growth
description: Quarterly OCF vs same quarter one year earlier.
methodology: value / value(1y earlier) - 1. Not computed when prior value <= 0.

name: Operating cash flow
description: Net cash provided by operating activities, quarterly.
methodology: Same YTD -> quarterly treatment as capex_total.

name: Total revenue
description: Total company revenue, quarterly. Q4 is derived as FY - 9M YTD.

name: Revenue YoY growth
description: Quarterly revenue vs same quarter one year earlier.
methodology: value / value(1y earlier) - 1.

name: Moody's Baa corporate yield minus 10Y Treasury
description: FRED series BAA10Y (daily). Investment-grade (Baa) credit spread; licence "Copyrighted - citation required" (Moody's via FRED), cited here. ICE BofA high-yield OAS series are NOT used (FRED: pre-approval required).
warning: Investment-grade Baa spread, not high-yield and not data-center specific.
methodology: fredgraph.csv?id=BAA10Y. Source: Moody's, retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis. publication_date approximated as observation_date.

name: US 10Y Treasury yield (constant maturity)
description: FRED series DGS10 (daily). Cost-of-capital context for long-duration AI capex.
methodology: Downloaded from fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=DGS10. publication_date is approximated as observation_date (no ALFRED vintage).

name: US 2Y Treasury yield (constant maturity)
description: FRED series DGS2 (daily; Federal Reserve H.15, public domain).
methodology: fred.stlouisfed.org/graph/fredgraph.csv?id=DGS2. publication_date approximated as observation_date (no ALFRED vintage).

name: US 10Y minus 2Y Treasury spread
description: FRED series T10Y2Y (daily; computed by FRED from H.15; copyright citation required - cited here).
methodology: fredgraph.csv?id=T10Y2Y. Source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED). publication_date approximated as observation_date.

name: Monthly revenue (TWSE listed-company filing)
description: Consolidated monthly operating revenue filed by each listed company (by the 10th of the following month), from the TWSE open-data summary table. Each refresh carries the data month plus the prior month and the same month a year earlier as published comparatives, so history accumulates from the first refresh (2026-09 data).
warning: Total company revenue, not AI-only. 3231 Wistron and 6669 Wiwynn are AI-server ODMs (monthly revenue only).
methodology: openapi.twse.com.tw/v1/opendata/t187ap05_L; NT$ thousands x 1000; publication_date = 出表日期 (table date).

name: Monthly revenue YoY (exchange-published)
description: 營業收入-去年同月增減(%) from t187ap05_L, stored as a fraction.
methodology: openapi.twse.com.tw/v1/opendata/t187ap05_L field 營業收入-去年同月增減(%) / 100.

name: Year-to-date revenue YoY (exchange-published)
description: 累計營業收入-前期比較增減(%) from t187ap05_L (calendar YTD through the data month), stored as a fraction.
methodology: openapi.twse.com.tw/v1/opendata/t187ap05_L field 累計營業收入-前期比較增減(%) / 100.

name: Forward P/E (consensus EPS)
description: Forward P/E requires analyst consensus EPS estimates, which are licensed data (FactSet, LSEG, S&P, Bloomberg). No free, terms-compliant source exists. UNAVAILABLE for all tickers. Do NOT substitute trailing P/E.
warning: Unavailable - consensus estimates are licensed.

name: Market capitalization (US listings, derived)
description: Raw close (Tiingo / Alpha Vantage) x latest SEC cover-page shares outstanding dated on or before the price date (<=120 days old; TSM <=400 days, annual 20-F), share count split-adjusted for splits in between. TSM ADR price x ordinary shares / 5. Unavailable without a price key; GOOGL and META unavailable (no non-dimensional share count).
warning: Derived, not a vendor market cap. Share count lags (cover-page date); buybacks/issuance since then are not reflected. GOOGL/META UNAVAILABLE.
methodology: us_price_close_t x us_shares_outstanding(latest as-of date <= t, max age 120d / TSM 400d) x prod(splits in (as-of, t]) x scale (TSM 0.2).

name: Dividend yield (TWSE-computed)
description: Dividend yield published daily by TWSE (BWIBBU_ALL), stored as a fraction.

name: Drawdown from 52-week high (TWSE close)
description: close / max(close over the trailing 365 days) - 1. Only computed when a full 52-week window of history exists.
warning: Unadjusted closes: ex-dividend drops slightly overstate the drawdown.
methodology: value_t / max(value over (t-365d, t]) - 1; requires the first observation to be <= t-358d.

name: Market capitalization (TWD)
description: Closing price x common shares issued.
warning: Uses the nearest shares snapshot within 45 days; shares history starts when ingestion started.
methodology: tw_price_close x tw_shares_outstanding (nearest shares snapshot within 45 days of the price date).

name: Price / book (TWSE-computed)
description: P/B ratio published daily by TWSE (BWIBBU_ALL).

name: Trailing P/E (TWSE-computed)
description: Price / earnings ratio published daily by TWSE (BWIBBU_ALL): closing price over the trailing four quarters' EPS. This is a TRAILING multiple, NOT forward P/E. Empty when EPS is negative or unavailable.
methodology: openapi.twse.com.tw/v1/exchangeReport/BWIBBU_ALL (latest trading day only; history accumulates one snapshot per run).

name: Closing price (TWSE)
description: Daily closing price from the Taiwan Stock Exchange (TWD, NOT adjusted for dividends).
methodology: www.twse.com.tw exchangeReport/STOCK_DAY (monthly JSON, one request per stock-month, >= 3 s apart). ROC dates converted to ISO.

name: Common shares issued (TWSE company profile)
description: 已發行普通股數 from TWSE open data t187ap03_L (listed-company basic information), snapshot per run.
methodology: openapi.twse.com.tw/v1/opendata/t187ap03_L; observation date = 出表日期 (table date).

name: Drawdown from 52-week high (US, split-adjusted close)
description: As tw_drawdown_52w, from us_price_split_adj. Needs 52 weeks of stored history (Tiingo provides 10+ years; Alpha Vantage compact only ~100 days).
methodology: value_t / max(value over (t-365d, t]) - 1 on us_price_split_adj; requires the first observation to be <= t-358d.

name: US equity index close (NASDAQ-100, NASDAQ Composite, PHLX Semiconductor)
description: Daily closes from FRED public CSV (no key): NASDAQ100, NASDAQCOM, NASDAQSOX (source Nasdaq, Inc., copyrighted; used for personal research with attribution). Price-return indices (no dividends). These are the indices behind the QQQ (NASDAQ-100) proxy and the SOX benchmark.
warning: Price-return index levels. FRED NASDAQSOX has occasional repeated/stale values in early history.
methodology: FRED fredgraph.csv; publication_date approximated as observation date (no vintages). Missing '.' days skipped.

name: Drawdown from 52-week high (US indices)
description: As tw_drawdown_52w, from us_index_close (NASDAQ-100, NASDAQ Composite, PHLX Semiconductor).
methodology: value_t / max(value over (t-365d, t]) - 1; requires the first observation to be <= t-358d.

name: Closing price (US listing, raw)
description: Daily raw (unadjusted) close from Tiingo EOD (official API, free Starter key TIINGO_API_KEY; 30+ years of history). Alpha Vantage TIME_SERIES_DAILY (ALPHAVANTAGE_API_KEY, ~100 sessions) is an alternative source. With neither key set every series is UNAVAILABLE. No keyless, terms-compliant per-stock source exists.
warning: Requires TIINGO_API_KEY (or ALPHAVANTAGE_API_KEY). Raw close, not split/dividend adjusted. TSM = NYSE ADR (1 ADR = 5 shares).

name: Split-adjusted close (US listing, price return)
description: Raw close divided by the product of later split factors. NOT dividend-adjusted, so it is a price-return series comparable with the FRED price-return indices.
warning: Price return only (dividends excluded). Revised whenever a new split is recorded.
methodology: us_price_close_t / prod(us_split_factor_s for split dates s > t).

name: 1-year relative price return vs NASDAQ-100
description: (P_t / P_t-365d) / (NDX_t / NDX_t-365d) - 1 using split-adjusted closes and the FRED NASDAQ100 index.
warning: Price return only (dividends excluded on both sides). Needs a price key (Tiingo / Alpha Vantage).
methodology: Base = last observation on/before t-365d (within 7 days) in both series; t must exist in both (no fill).

name: 1-year relative price return vs PHLX Semiconductor (SOX)
description: (P_t / P_t-365d) / (SOX_t / SOX_t-365d) - 1 using split-adjusted closes and the FRED NASDAQSOX index.
warning: Price return only (dividends excluded on both sides). Needs a price key (Tiingo / Alpha Vantage).
methodology: Base = last observation on/before t-365d (within 7 days) in both series; t must exist in both (no fill).

name: Common shares outstanding (SEC cover page)
description: dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding from SEC EDGAR companyfacts (cover page of each 10-Q/10-K/20-F), dated at the cover 'as of' date. Multi-class issuers GOOGL and META tag shares per class only (dimensional facts not in companyfacts), so they are excluded rather than guessed. TSM: ordinary shares from the annual 20-F.
warning: GOOGL / META not covered (multi-class, per-class facts only). TSM snapshot is annual.

name: Stock split factor (US listing)
description: Tiingo splitFactor on ex-dates where it differs from 1 (new shares per old share). Used to split-adjust prices and EDGAR share counts.
warning: Only stored on split days; absence means no split reported by Tiingo (Alpha Vantage free tier has no split data).
